_meta.description: Weapon Master subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: armor pen, crit, CDR/speed.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la penetration d'armure de 1.2% et la penetration magique de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases armor penetration by 1.2% and magic penetration by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats critiques de 0.8% et la chance de critique de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases crit damage by 0.8% and crit chance by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la reduction de temps de recharge de 1% et la vitesse d'attaque de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases cooldown reduction by 1% and attack speed by 0.5% per level.
